original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: The Mirror Archive stands open with a calm blue survey light visible through its brass-bound entrance.
The Furnace Vault gate stands open around a steady amber forge glow.
The Thorn Crown Hollow entrance is open beneath its living thorn dome and green claim lantern.
The recovered storm bell hangs upright above calmer wreck timbers and a warm pilot lantern.
The Prism Ossuary doors stand open around a restrained violet-white survey beam.
The Basalt Oath Tomb doors stand open beneath steady gold runes and blue-amber interior light.
The Sealed Muster Fort gate stands open around a lit courtyard with orderly shield and spear racks.
The Kiln Chain Redoubt glows with controlled furnace light behind an open gate and lowered chains.
The Brasswake Depot hatch stands open above a loading ramp, uncovered supply crates, and a clean steam plume.
Bridge Bastion with its portcullis raised, deck clear, and two warm route lamps lit.
Chainboom Fort with both chains raised to their winches and the harbor lane open.
Railblock Camp with carts moved aside and an uninterrupted lit track through the tents.
Rootgate Den opened around a broad earthen tunnel with a teal guide light beyond.
Fog Quay cleared of ambush crates and rope traps, with guide lanterns along the open pier.
Mirror Toll Causeway with barriers folded aside and a continuous silver-blue lane.
Ashbarb spikes dismantled to both verges around a broad open stone road.
Frostford Hold with portcullis raised, bridge clear, and blue-white welcome lamps lit.
A used menders tent with tidy treatment table, depleted medicines, and a softly dimmed field lantern.
A courier change post after exchange, with resting mounts, shifted saddlebags, and a lowered green route flag.
A contract booth with sealed scroll bundles, closed leather ledger, set-aside quill, and a low amber lamp.
A reedboat stand with an emptied rack, provision crate and coiled rope already loaded into the woven boat.
An ash-route kitchen with covered cauldron, stacked bowls, banked embers, and pale cooling vapor.
A survey cart with its large prism steadily aligned and its smaller instruments folded and packed away.
The Oath Ember Shrine after its rite, with a steady low flame, warm oath carvings, and a fresh ember seal.
The Reedscript Vow Shrine with a newly sealed teal-gold cord, calm marsh candle, and illuminated base seal.
The Prism Measure Shrine after calibration, with aligned facets, cyan-gold glints, and a softly lit survey emblem.
The Root Accord Ring renewed with fresh shoots, four warm pact lights, and a luminous spiral stone.
The Furnace Oath Marker with banked coals, steady fork-rune glow, and a smith hammer resting on the step.
The Tide Bell Shrine just rung, with a fresh sailor knot, pale mist echoes, and bright tide-pool ripples.
A captured hilltop signal nest with a blue-white watch fire, taut teal pennant, and lit platform runes.
A captured marsh listening post with three outward brass horns, teal sound rings, and a fresh survey ribbon.
A captured prism survey frame with an aligned bright lens, cyan-gold ray, and illuminated meridian circle.
A captured echo well with cyan water rings, an amber plumb light, and teal receiver lamps in both horns.
A captured coast bell watch with pale resonance arcs, a cyan harbor lantern, and raised blue-gold pennant.
